name: DH-17/E-11 hybrid custom
description: A DH-17/E-11 hybrid custom was a hybridized blaster rifle built from an E-11 medium blaster rifle and a DH-17 blaster pistol. Weeteef Cyu-Bee owned one such customized blaster, which was "tibanna-jacked."
